subject: Energy
title: Frequency Regulation
description: A quick, practical guide to Frequency Regulation.

hook.text: Grid frequency must stay within a tight band—even a 1% deviation signals serious trouble.

buildup.text: Primary response is automatic—generators speed up or slow down within seconds using governor controls.

discovery.text: Secondary response dispatches reserves over minutes—operators send commands to bring frequency back to target.

twist.text: Battery storage can respond in milliseconds—far faster than any thermal plant, making it ideal for frequency service.

climax.text: Inertia from spinning generators naturally resists frequency changes—but renewables (with no spinning mass) reduce this.

punchline.text: Hold the frequency steady—or the whole grid stumbles.

quiz.question: What provides the fastest frequency regulation?
